title: Maaşım.net Search, AI Visibility ve Hesaplama Funnel Dashboard

google_search_console_generative_ai.connection_mode: Search Console native report or exported report data; do not assume API/Looker connector parity until verified
google_search_console_generative_ai.availability_note: Google states the report was rolled out worldwide by 2026-08-31; low-volume properties may still show no report data.

bing_webmaster_tools.connection_mode: Bing Webmaster Tools native report/export; keep separate from GA4 unless a supported common grain exists

attribution_guardrail.rule: Classic GSC query data and GA4 behavior data may only be joined at date + normalized landing page path grain.
attribution_guardrail.reason: Google does not expose a user- or session-level key connecting an organic query to a GA4 conversion.
attribution_guardrail.prohibited_metric: Exact calculation completions by search query
allowed_outputs: Exact GSC query, page, click, impression, CTR and position metrics
Exact GA4 landing page sessions and calculator event metrics
Query drill-through to its landing page funnel without assigning the page conversion count to every query

google: Generative AI impressions measure visibility, not visits or conversions.
Do not infer AI Mode or AI Overview clicks when the dedicated report only exposes impressions.
Do not join Generative AI report rows to GA4 conversions as if they shared a user, query or session identifier.
If report data is exported manually, retain the export date and report date range.
bing: Total citations measure references in supported AI answers; they are not ranking positions.
Average cited pages is an aggregate visibility measure and does not indicate authority or placement within an answer.
Grounding queries are a sample of retrieval phrases and must not be treated as complete search-demand data.
Bing citation counts must remain separate from GA4 conversions unless a supported common key and grain become available.
referral_traffic: GA4 AI referral sessions only represent users who clicked through to the site.
A citation or generative AI impression can occur without producing a referral session.
Referral sessions must not be used as a substitute for Google or Bing native AI visibility metrics.
